_README: Config for fetch_ats.mjs. Each source pulls live postings from an employer's ATS JSON API (NOT HTML scraping), so it is not bot-blocked the way WebFetch is. Add employers here as their ATS slug is confirmed. Supported providers: greenhouse, lever, ashby, smartrecruiters, workday, successfactors, google. Slugs are the account name in the ATS URL (e.g. job-boards.greenhouse.io/<slug>, jobs.lever.co/<slug>, jobs.ashbyhq.com/<slug>, jobs.smartrecruiters.com/<slug>). For workday set slug to '<tenant>/<site>' and host to the *.myworkdayjobs.com host. For successfactors omit slug and set 'host' to the SAP career-site host (e.g. jobs.six-group.com, careers.swissre.com) plus 'queries'; note the SF career host answers plain HTTP even when the employer's corporate marketing site is bot-walled. For google omit slug and instead set 'locations' (array of 'City, Country') and 'queries' (array of search terms).
_PRIMARY_README: primaryLocationFilters is the TOP-TIER slice of locationFilters — the candidate's #1 target region (see searchBrief.targetLocations in config/candidate.json). fetch_ats.mjs sorts candidates[] so these come first and reports meta.primaryCount, so agents curating top-down exhaust the primary region before the backup tier. Leave it empty to disable the ordering.
